concept: Optimal solution using Array, Dynamic Programming
trick_english: Identify constraints and formulate invariant before coding.
trick_hinglish: Problem ko simplify karo aur step by step solve karo.

summary_hinglish: Minimum XOR Path in a Grid ka simple solution aur logic.

title: Count Islands With Total Value Divisible by K
concept: Implicit Graph Connected Components with In-Place Visited Invalidation (Sink to 0) and Accumulator Modulo Test.
trick_english: Sink & Sum on Sight: As soon as grid[r][c] > 0 is found, run iterative DFS, sink visited cells to 0, sum the island values, and check sum % k == 0.
trick_hinglish: Dekhte Hi Sink Karo Aur Jodte Chalo: Grid me loop chalao, positive cell milte hi DFS se cluster ke saare cells jodo aur unhe 0 kar do. Last me sum % k == 0 check karo!
summary_english: Given an m x n matrix and positive integer k, find all 4-directionally connected clusters of positive cells whose total sum is divisible by k.
summary_hinglish: Matrix me positive cells ka connected island dhoondhna hai aur unka sum k se divide hota hai ya nahi (sum % k == 0) wo count karke return karna hai.
topics_needed: Matrix as Implicit Graph (4 cardinal directions)

stages_summary.detail: Matrix dimensions up to 1000x1000, sum can exceed 32-bit limits.
Connected components traversal using DFS/BFS; sink cells to avoid secondary arrays.
Double loop over rows & cols. For cell > 0, run iterative stack DFS with accumulator.
Clean iterative DFS with cardinal offsets: [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)].
Verified on sample tests: g1 -> 2, g2 -> 0.
Time: O(M * N), Space: O(M * N) auxiliary stack.

title: Two Sum
concept: Single-pass Hash Map lookup for complement (target - current_number) in O(1) time.
trick_english: Look back, not forward: check if target - num exists in the map before recording the current number.
trick_hinglish: Aage dhoondhne ke bajaye peeche dekho! target - num agar pehle dictionary me hai toh dono index return karo.
summary_english: Given an array of integers and target, return indices of two numbers that add up to target.
summary_hinglish: Array me do aise numbers ke index nikaalne hain jinka sum target ke barabar ho.

stages_summary.detail: Exactly one valid answer, cannot use same element twice.
Hash Map allows O(N) single pass vs O(N^2) brute force.
Iterate through array, check target - num in map, then add num -> index.
Passed tests with duplicates and negative numbers.
